item.title: meditation calm after exercise; appreciating life bold
item.description:
meditation/calm after exercise; appreciating life #bold 22:52:52. march 18th, 2026 im biking through stanford on a downwards slope i rush through the wind like a runner full of adrenaline. i am full of adrenaline. speed makes me happy toward the station, i weave on the roads with not a car in sight down the ramp into the tunnel and out i come onto the station im exhausted but energetic i sit on a maroon bench on the south side of the north bound palo alto caltrain station sweating, i take off my glasses, and take my keys and phone out of my pockets. i unbuckle my helmet i plug in my front bike light and sit there while four drops of sweat slide slowly down the sides of my head i move my hands to wipe and then back nothing cars woosh by behind me i close my eyes. leaning into the 120 degree metal grid "back rest" hurts, do i dont instead, i sit up and breathe one deep breath is all that takse for me to become serene a deep sense of pleasure flows through my lungs into my body as i inhale bike light blue flashing; charging brick; backpack and bike and helmet and phone; four lamp posts on the other side with bright lights, unmoving; orange lights are evil twins. train arrives.
#A #experience
item.guid: ideaflow/2026-03-18/meditation calm after exercise; appreciating life bold.md

item.title: consciousness
item.description: consciousnessThe idea of becoming conscious, or, you know, becoming a gentic, or, like, understanding the world around you and yourself, is it interesting that thing that I could probably write about? I think a good framing is like, you know, something like on becoming conscious, right? I think it's fairly understandable, and... the certain things inside are fairly explainable. I think a couple aspects outline what I think I mean by this. One is, like, you know, understand... Sorry. Understanding of yourself, right? There are definitely many tears of this. Especially the world. I mean, that's easier to explain. First, here is, like, what the fuck is the world, right? Like, you're not aware that there is such a thing as, like, an environment and, you know, you're not aware that there's a separation between you and the environment, and you can do certain things. Um... So that definitely kind of ties into, like, the understanding of you, uh, and your relationship to the environment. These are all kind of related. Um, and then there's, uh... a understanding which is like, Oh, yeah, there is an environment, and, you know, you're in it, and you do things, right? And then there's a understanding of like, how does the environment work? Like, what happens when you do certain actions? What happens when other people do certain actions? What happens when other things sue certain actions? Like, are there predictable patterns? And, you know, yes, there are. And then there are higher levels of understanding that are like, what are the dynamics that arise? When there are people like us, and when there are environments such as the one that we have? et cetera. And there are more higher dimensions as well. And then there's, like, the self understanding, and I think self understanding is the most important of, like, self goals as well. Like, you know, like, you're in this world, and you're acting, and you're like, Why am I acting? Like, why do I do the things that I do? Um, is there for some goal or something? Um, I think that's a part of being conscious as well. And then there's kind of, like, opinions, you know, strategies for existing the world and interacting with other people. #towrite

item.title: just hopped on a train, sat down, and just stared outside (d
item.description:
